scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind protecting private information.
Personal information: includes home address and passwords. Password: is a private account secret.
Phishing: is a trick to obtain private details. Two-step verification: adds another account-protection check. Trusted adult: helps children decide what to share.
Use an imaginary example or a teacher-approved offline screenshot. Discuss when to use personal information and password. Never enter a real password or share private details in this activity.
